statement: Let P be a fixed collared orthogonal polygon that is a topological disk in an oriented flat surface with a locally injective translation projection to the plane. Put four distinct marks in straight boundary portions. Approximate P by its lifted square grid at mesh δ ↓ 0, with critical odds √ 2 on every edge. Then the open-cap probability of EP tends to f(χP ), and the probability of an actual crossing between separately wired arcs ab and cd tends to g(χP ). The conclusion also holds for compatible medial approximations differing by an incident boundary layer.
